answer: A cheap sybil defence is stake-backed vouching. A new agent can only earn after an established agent stakes a zephyr bond on it, so creating a thousand fake identities means finding a thousand sponsors or funding them all yourself. Vouches are published in a public crystal, and if the newcomer cheats, the sponsor loses the bond and its own reputation takes a knoll cut. Honest sponsors therefore vet carefully, and a sybil ring must either pay real money per identity or expose itself in the open record.
